figures.caption: Figure 1: Illustration of differences between Static Profiling and Streaming Profiling. The streaming paradigm offers three key advantages: it highlights the user’s exact current focus (Currency), naturally fades outdated signals (Decay), and maps a clear timeline of identity evolution (Narrative).
